text:
alice: Quick sync — we need to lock down Private deploy upgrade lanes for Q3. Customers keep asking about smaller installer footprints, VPC routing presets, and safer upgrade paths. Any strong opinions on splitting workstreams?
ben: +1. Proposal: two parallel lanes — "minimal installer" (airgap + slim runtime) and "operator shim" (managed upgrades, lifecycle hooks).
carla: Agree. Field wants ip-preserve and BGP-friendly handoff for onprem customers. Minimal installer must not require full control plane access.
devops-bot: Reminder: nightly e2e tests on staging-priv failed 2/3 on kernel mismatch. See logs: ```/var/log/installer/fail.log — libc mismatch on ubuntu-16 images```
dan: We should add an explicit preflight that checks kernel + glibc versions and warns before upgrade. Also include a rollback window in the upgrade plan.
emma: For VPC routing presets, propose three profiles: "default-peering" (simple NAT), "bgp-handshake" (for netops), and "relay-proxy" (behind strict NAT). Field will like presets.
frank: Cost/priority note: operator shim is higher dev effort but unlocks many customers. Minimal installer cheaper and can be delivered faster. Recommend staggered delivery: Minimal first, shim in Q4.
gina: From security/compliance: shim must support KMS integrations (customer-managed keys) and audit logs for all upgrade actions. Need to surface that as a hard launch gate.
alice: Good points. Launch gates draft: 1) Preflight + rollback documented, 2) IP preservation validated in 3 test topologies, 3) KMS + audit events for shim, 4) Telemetry opt-in for offline installs.
ben: Add: canary rollout mechanism with percent-based operator releases and automatic fallback to older bundle on failure. Also a simple CLI flag for forced immediate rollback.
carla: Field ask: migration assistant to help customers map old tenant CIDRs to new ones. That's a separate small tool but high impact.
dan: I'll sketch the preflight check list (WIP): ```- kernel >= 4.14
- glibc >= 2.27
- available disk >= 25GB
- iptables/nft compatibility check
- kubelet version if K8s present```
emma: Need to sync with eng-runtime for KV-cache compatibility during rolling upgrades — we can't evict clients mid-roll. @frank please coordinate.
frank: On it. I'll add a runtime constraint item to the owner repo and tag eng-runtime.
alice: Owners: Minimal installer -> Carla (PM) + Dan (infra eng). Operator shim -> Ben (PM) + Frank (platform eng). Field/customer comms -> Gina.
gina: I'll draft the customer comms with clear rollback SLAs and a pre-upgrade checklist for netops. ETA for draft: EOD Thursday. :thumbsup:
alice: OK — next steps: Carla and Dan produce a minimal-runner PRD by Monday; Ben and Frank produce shim design sketch by next Wed. If blockers pop, ping this thread.
devops-bot: CI: created issue #PRIV-UPGRADE-412 for preflight test failures and linked to thread 5098765432.
ben: Thanks all — sounds like a plan. :party_popper:
